title: Parklife
studio_context: Maison Rouge and RAK, from August 1993, with Stephen Street; Rowntree credited with drums, percussion, programming and crowd noise.

drum_performances.name: Dave Rowntree
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The album that made Britpop: Parklife's open hat on every beat with the snare slanting onto the 'and' of 4, and Girls & Boys, the drum machine he programmed instead of playing.

evidence.note: Girls & Boys is his programming, not his playing.
